rawContent: "Five years later, and at the heels of the #metoo movement and the 46th anniversary of Title IX, I am glad that our complaint pushed campus sexual assault and Title IX to the national agenda." https://t.co/KRwgejyaUg
"Millions and millions of people literally raised their hands nine months ago to say #MeToo and their hands are still raised. Because nobody is responding to them." https://t.co/b1eBg6hQaS

"People are simply taking the infrastructure that already exists—#MeToo, the movement and the hashtag—and appending additional ideas to it. They are, in that, asking too much of #MeToo" https://t.co/m8hQCSIVgT

"#MeToo and the women behind it have shown that five-year-old girl that she is not alone. #MeToo has shown this eighteen-year-old girl that she is so much stronger than she could fathom, that she isn’t a victim, she’s a survivor."

https://t.co/f1vBVo817U

"As a sex worker, I know if I were to speak up, that I would be dismissed, not believed, blamed... I am not treated with the same respect that most women are, and that has continued over to the #metoo movement.” https://t.co/LFzK2uXcBx

"It has taken me a while to get comfortable with my trans identity, immersed as I was in our transphobic society. The #MeToo movement has helped . . I am a trans man who has lived both sides and can play a useful part in these discussions."
